name: Yōngbīng Zhàngē

name: Yōkaimaki
summary: The blood moon has risen once again, meaning the yōkai (cryptids) have emerged from the murky depths of the sea. As the heir to the family restaurant, use your fishing and cooking skills to serve up some delicious yōkai sushi!

name: Yōulì: Yasashii Lìxiǎn
summary: A young boy named User sets out to rescue his family from the clutches of a demon. Together with his friends Leon and Kancer, they venture into underground ruins in search of treasure to pay off a debt to the demon — but deep within those ruins, they accidentally awaken a girl who has long been sleeping…
